lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so tikaa so baihanaa soee deebaan ||
lines.translation: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: piyoo daade jevihaa potaa paravaan ||
lines.translation: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੈ ਘਤਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin baasak netrai ghatiaa kar nehee taan ||
lines.translation: He took the thousand-headed serpent as his churning string, and with the force of devotional love,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਮਧਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin samu(n)d viroliaa kar mer madhaan ||
lines.translation: he churned the ocean of the world with his churning stick, the Sumayr mountain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaudah ratan nikaalian keeton chaanaan ||
lines.translation: He extracted the fourteen jewels, and brought forth the Divine Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੋੜਾ ਕੀਤੋ ਸਹਜ ਦਾ ਜਤੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਲਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghoRaa keeto sahaj daa jat keeo palaan ||
lines.translation: He made intuition his horse, and chastity his saddle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਓ ਸਤ ਦਾ ਜਸ ਹੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanakh chaRaaio sat daa jas ha(n)daa baan ||
lines.translation: He placed the arrow of the Lord's Praise in the bow of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੂ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਰੈ ਭਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal vich dhoo a(n)dhaar saa chaRiaa rai bhaan ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there was only pitch darkness. Then, He rose like the sun to illuminate the darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਓ ਸਤਹੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satahu khet jamaaio satahu chhaavaan ||
lines.translation: He farms the field of Truth, and spreads out the canopy of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਰਸੋਈ ਤੇਰੀਐ ਘਿਉ ਮੈਦਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit rasoee tereeai ghiu maidaa khaan ||
lines.translation: Your kitchen always has ghee and flour to eat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਸੁਝੀਓਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa(n) sujheeos man mahi sabad paravaan ||
lines.translation: You understand the four corners of the universe; in your mind, the Word of the Shabad is approved and supreme.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaario kar nadar neesaan ||
lines.translation: You eliminate the comings and goings of reincarnation, and bestow the insignia of Your Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਤਰਿਆ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: autariaa autaar lai so purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: You are the Avataar, the Incarnation of the all-knowing Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਖੜਿ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhakhaR vaau na dolaee parabat meraan ||
lines.translation: You are not pushed or shaken by the storm and the wind; you are like the Sumayr Mountain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanai birathaa jee kee jaanee hoo jaan ||
lines.translation: You know the inner state of the soul; You are the Knower of knowers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਜਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa saalaahee sache paatisaah jaa(n) too sughaR sujaan ||
lines.translation: How can I praise You, O True Supreme King, when You are so wise and all-knowing?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daan j satigur bhaavasee so sate daan ||
lines.translation: Those blessings granted by the Pleasure of the True Guru - please bless Satta with those gifts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਦਾ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਮਤਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ha(n)daa chhatr sir umat hairaan ||
lines.translation: Seeing Nanak's canopy waving over Your head, everyone was astonished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so tikaa so baihanaa soee deebaan ||
lines.translation: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: piyoo daade jevihaa potraa paravaan ||6||
lines.translation: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n raamadaas gur jin siriaa tinai savaariaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooree hoee karaamaat aap sirajanahaarai dhaariaa ||
lines.translation: Perfect is Your miracle; the Creator Lord Himself has installed You on the throne.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖੀ ਅਤੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sikhee atai sa(n)gatee paarabraham kar namasakaariaa ||
lines.translation: The Sikhs and all the Congregation recognize You as the Supreme Lord God, and bow down to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: atal athaahu atol too teraa a(n)t na paaraavaariaa ||
lines.translation: You are unchanging, unfathomable and immeasurable; You have no end or limitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee too(n) seviaa bhaau kar se tudh paar utaariaa ||
lines.translation: Those who serve You with love - You carry them across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: lab lobh kaam krodh mohu maar kadhe tudh saparavaariaa ||
lines.translation: Greed, envy, sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment - You have beaten them and driven them out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੈਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s teraa thaan hai sach teraa paisakaariaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed is Your place, and True is Your magnificent glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak too lahanaa toohai gur amar too veechaariaa ||
lines.translation: You are Nanak, You are Angad, and You are Amar Daas; so do I recognize You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur dithaa taa(n) man saadhaariaa ||7||
lines.translation: When I saw the Guru, then my mind was comforted and consoled. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chaain aape hoaa ||
lines.translation: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥੰਮੑਿ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapeenhai aap saajion aape hee tha(n)mhi khaloaa ||
lines.translation: He created Himself, and He Himself is the supporting pillar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape patee kalam aap aap likhanahaaraa hoaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the paper, He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the writer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh umat aavan jaavanee aape hee navaa niroaa ||
lines.translation: All His followers come and go; He alone is fresh and new.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਵੈ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: takhat baithaa arajan guroo satigur kaa khivai cha(n)doaa ||
lines.translation: Guru Arjun sits on the throne; the royal canopy waves over the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੈ ਆਥਵਣਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਚਕੀ ਕੀਅਨੁ ਲੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ugavanahu tai aathavanahu chahu chakee keean loaa ||
lines.translation: From east to west, He illuminates the four directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਪਇਆ ਮੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee guroo na sevio manamukhaa paiaa moaa ||
lines.translation: Those self-willed manmukhs who do not serve the Guru die in shame.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਣੀ ਚਉਣੀ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: doonee chaunee karaamaat sache kaa sachaa dhoaa ||
lines.translation: Your miracles increase two-fold, even four-fold; this is the True Lord's true blessing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chaain aape hoaa ||8||1||
lines.translation: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee baanee bhagataa kee || kabeer jeeu ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਮੇਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kalaalan laahan melau gur kaa sabad guR keen re ||
lines.translation: Make your body the vat, and mix in the yeast. Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the molasses.
